data.name: Rasmiyah
data.gender_notes: Rasmiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rasmiyah is an Arabic name that means 'official' or 'formal'. It is a name that symbolizes structure and discipline. The name Rasmiyah carries the meaning “Official or Formal” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rasmiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody official or formal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rasmiyah is a name that reflects the importance of following rules and regulations in one's life.
data.etymology: Rasmiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Official or Formal.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rasmiyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رسمية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الرسمية أو الرسمي في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رسمية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'رسم' والذي يعني الرسم أو التخطيط. الاسم يستخدم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الرسمية أو الأهمية الرسمية. وقد ورد في بعض المصادر اللغوية العربية أن الاسم يعني أيضًا الاستقرار أو الثبات.

in_urdu.name: رسمیہ
in_urdu.meaning: رسميہ نام کا مطلب ہے رسمی یا مستقل
in_urdu.long_meaning: رسمیہ نام عربی زبان کی 'رسم' جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ڈرائی یا منصوبہ بندی کرنا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں رسمی یا مستقل کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रसमिया
in_hindi.meaning: रसमिया नाम का अर्थ है आधिकारिक या स्थायी
in_hindi.long_meaning: रसमिया नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के 'रसम' मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है ड्रॉइंग या प्लानिंग। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में आधिकारिक या स्थायी अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: رسميہ
in_pashto.meaning: رسميہ نوم د رسمي يا دايمي معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رسميہ نوم د عربي ژبې د 'رسم' ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د رسم يا پلان معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني په دوديزو کې د رسمي يا دايمي په معنی کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Rasmiyah
in_english.meaning: Rasmiyah means official, formal, or permanent
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rasmiyah originates from the Arabic root 'رسم' (rasm), meaning drawing, planning, or sketching. It signifies formality, officialness, or permanence. Historically, the term has been used in Islamic tradition to denote something officially recognized or established. The name Rasmiyah carries connotations of stability, reliability, and formality across Muslim cultures.
